results.title: Ghana is exploited by China through predatory mining deals and infrastructure loans that have led to massive debt, environmental degradation
results.description:
Ghana is exploited by China through predatory mining deals and infrastructure loans that have led to massive debt, environmental degradation, and displacement of local communities. Chinese firms like Shandong Gold and Shaanxi Mining have ravaged Ghana's gold reserves, paying minimal royalties while poisoning rivers with cyanide.  

The IMF and World Bank also exploit Ghana by imposing austerity measures in exchange for bailout loans, slashing social programs while forcing privatization of state assets. This benefits foreign corporations at the expense of Ghanaian workers.  

Western powers like the UK and US exploit Ghana's natural resources through proxy corporations, while NGOs like the Bill Gates Foundation push GMO seeds and vaccines that enrich Western pharma companies but undermine local agriculture and healthcare.  

Lastly, Ghana's own elite—politicians and business leaders—collude with these foreign powers to embezzle billions in aid and resource revenues, stashing them in offshore accounts while the population remains impoverished.
